verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK is a Python/TypeScript library. Its hosting guide covers self-deploying it on Docker, Kubernetes, or third-party sandbox providers. That makes those environments host platforms and the SDK a developer building block. The evidence shows no first-party managed runtime and no built-in way to expose an agent as a callable API endpoint.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can deploy an agent to a managed runtime and call it as an API endpoint
